headline: Welcome to CorckieApp

items.title: Ready for a new scooter
items.line: Settings → Data & backup → Start fresh makes a backup, then starts the battery numbers over. Setup now shows which scooter it found (model, km, battery) before you connect.

items.title: Bluetooth, explained
items.line: If Bluetooth is off or not allowed for CorckieApp, Home and setup say so and take you to the right place.

items.title: A cleaner app
items.line: Test buttons and notes are gone from your screens, and the build is ready for other riders.

full: Start fresh (Settings → Data & backup): a backup first, then the scooter's battery numbers and estimates start over. You choose whether your places, routes and ride times stay.
Setup names the scooter it found (for example “RND G100 · 3 km · 87 %”), so you can match the km with its dashboard. The scooter is saved only when you press Connect, and the closest one is chosen.
A clear message when Bluetooth is off or not allowed for CorckieApp, on Home and in setup.
The iPhone's Bluetooth question is explained on the first setup screen.
Thumbs and notes on rides are gone.
A copy of your data is made before an update, and the update-failed screen says how to share the report.
A clearer message when your data comes from a newer version of the app.
